[[Category:Transformer]]

An '''autoregressive decoder-only Transformer (ADoT)''' is a [[Transformer]] architecture that retains only the decoder stack, so that each position attends to itself and to earlier positions only.

== Defining property: Causal restriction ==

See [[self-attention causal mask (Transformer)]].

== Characteristics ==

=== Training ===

$$
P_\theta(x_t\mid x_{1:t-1}),\, t=1,\cdots,T,
$$

can be calculated simultaneously if $\vec x=(x_1,\dots,x_T)$ is fully known. So training can be highly parallelised.

=== Inference ===

$$
P_\theta(x_1,\cdots,x_T)=\prod_{t=1}^{T}P_\theta(x_t\mid x_{1:t-1}),
$$

Hence ADoT is highly adapted for [[large language model (LLM)#Typical_implementation:_sequential_next_token_prediction|sequential next token prediction]].
